name.ar: الدمج على خط واحد: fast-forward يحرّك المؤشر ويحدّث الملفات
name.en: Merging on one line: fast-forward moves the pointer and updates files

tests.code:
g2 = MiniGit()
g2.change('a.txt', 'v1')
g2.commit('one')
g2.branch('dev')
g2.checkout('dev')
g2.change('b.txt', 'v1')
g2.commit('two')
g2.checkout('main')
result = g2.merge('dev')
assert result == 'fast-forward', 'expected: fast-forward | actual: %r' % result
assert g2.branches['main'] == 'c2', 'expected: c2 | actual: %r' % g2.branches['main']
assert g2.files['b.txt'] == 'v1', 'expected: v1 | actual: %r' % g2.files['b.txt']
tests.expected: fast-forward then c2 with b.txt v1

name.ar: التعارض يُقرأ من اللقطات لا من شجرة العمل
name.en: The conflict is read from snapshots, not the working tree

tests.code:
g3 = MiniGit()
g3.change('x.py', 'base')
g3.commit('base')
g3.branch('dev')
g3.change('z.py', 'main')
g3.commit('main side')
g3.checkout('dev')
g3.change('y.py', 'dev')
g3.commit('dev side')
g3.checkout('main')
result = g3.merge('dev')
assert result == 'merged', 'expected: merged | actual: %r' % result
tests.expected: merged when the changed sets do not overlap
